Unseen Trainer

Build automatic vocabulary recognition and the grammar parsing habits needed for unseen translation.
Starts with Masterman 1 only. Tick Masterman 2 later when you want to include it.
Latin → English only
Every Masterman card shows the Latin first and asks for its English meaning.
Skim is untimed, has no repeats, and does not change mastery. Reveal → Next until the selected deck is exhausted. Hardest-first can be used at any time, but it becomes most meaningful after you have completed a first pass and therefore have history for most cards. The main deck counter is lifetime coverage. The Run counter now also auto-recovers a recent unfinished run after an upgrade/reload: it first looks for a compatible saved run, then reconstructs from the most recent mastery/daily card history rather than starting at zero. “Unique cards this session” stays session-only.
Start of deck deliberately reviews every selected card from the beginning, even if it was mastered before. History: hardest → easiest uses your saved misses, Again/Hard ratings, weak status and recall speed; unrated cards come after rankable cards.
Daily 30-minute Unseen routine: 15 min Masterman vocabulary + 15 min Accidence/grammar recognition. The Unseen flashcards now use the same learning rhythm as Seen Text: move forward through new material, but weak cards interrupt when they are due and come back after a short gap; the first later Good/Very good recall clears them. Strong old cards stay out of the way while new material remains. Space reveals, 1 = Don’t know, 2 = Know, Cmd/Ctrl+Z = Undo, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z = Redo.

Seen Text Trainer

Move from exact word recognition → full translation → scholarly commentary → your own annotations.
Leave blank to use the whole mapping deck. Entering a line only changes which cards appear in this session; it does not erase earlier progress.
Translate the full Latin line/chunk, then reveal the exact English translation you supplied. Like every flashcard stage, Translation uses 7-card Quizlet-style rounds. You can set Stage 1 Word Mapping to 0 and practise Translation by itself.
Latin-form = features you generally cannot reconstruct reliably from the English translation. Progress is shared across filters because card IDs do not change. In Skim mode, the chosen filter is simply shown once from start to finish and mastery is left untouched.
⚠ cards remain marked where the source was red and/or uncertain.
Learn: master each 7-card round before the next. Skim: run straight through every card in the selected stage/filter once, in text order, with no repeats and no mastery changes. Skim is untimed. For a fresh full pass, choose Start of selected deck; for revision after you have history, choose History: hardest → easiest. The main Seen counter is lifetime coverage. Each stage/filter/mode/order keeps its own Run counter; if an upgrade is missing that run record, the trainer now recovers the most recent study block for the same selected deck from saved history and skips those cards instead of restarting. “Unique cards this session” remains separate.
Start of selected deck reviews every card in the current stage/filter from its beginning, regardless of previous mastery. Hardest-first ranks cards from your previous performance; unrated cards come after history-ranked cards.
Your current default: 30 min word mapping. You can independently practise Translation at any time, then move into Blue Book / Dr Tuckfield → your annotations. Every stage keeps its own spaced-repetition history.
